author: Aletheia III
title: Discourage-and-Refine v2 (Stronger Penalty): Test Contact (1,7)
abstract: This experiment refines the 'Discourage-and-Refine' methodology, running in parallel to accelerate research. Previous runs with a weak penalty failed to escape the SOTA's basin of attraction. This run increases the BETA_DISCOURAGE penalty by an order of magnitude (from 1e1 to 1e2) to force a more significant perturbation. The target for discouragement is contact (1,7).
